newsitem.title: VIETNAM: Vietnam says president recovering, must still rest.
newsitem.headline: Vietnam says president recovering, must still rest.

text.p: Vietnam said on Thursday President Le Duc Anh, who suffered a stroke last month, was getting better but had to take further rest.

"President Le Duc Anh is at present in the recovery process," Foreign Ministry spokesman Tran Quang Hoan told reporters at a briefing. "However, the president still has to continue resting at the request of his medical doctor."
The brief statement was, almost word for word, the same as the foreign ministry's last comment on the president's health two weeks ago.
Anh, 76, was admitted to a Hanoi hospital in mid-November suffering blood pressure problems, but a veil of secrecy has since been drawn across details of his condition.
Political sources say Anh, who is a member of the Communist country's septuagenarian leadership troika, is not expected to recover sufficiently to resume his duties.

Anh, a former army general, has been viewed as a powerful behind-the-scenes operator wielding strong influence over the military and internal security. Analysts say his departure from the political scene could trigger broader leadership changes.
